examples.en: Lloyd had urged her to eat caviar. She had shuddered at the thought.
examples.zh: 劳埃德已鼓动她吃鱼子酱。可她一想到这个就打哆嗦了。

examples.en: Lozano claimed that motorcycle driver Clement Lloyd was trying to run him down.
examples.zh: 洛扎诺声称摩托车手克莱门特•劳埃德当时正试图撞他。

examples.en: At this time, Northern reformers, such as William Lloyd Garrison and Samuel Chase, portrayed the framers of the United States Constitution as proponents of individual autonomy and capitalist values.
examples.zh: 当时，北方的改革者，如威廉·劳埃德·加里森和塞缪尔·蔡斯，把美国宪法的制定者描绘成个人自治和资本主义价值观的支持者。
